title: Sakana AI focuses on homegrown models for Japan
excerpt: Sakana AI's CEO explains that the company's local models aim to boost Japan's industrial competitiveness beyond national security.
body_html: Sakana AI is developing homegrown artificial intelligence models with the primary goal of boosting Japan's industrial competitiveness. According to the company's chief executive officer, these local AI systems are designed to address much more than just national security concerns.
